job_description.title: Head of AI Enablement, Truist Care Centers
job_description.summary: Bridge role between Truist's centralized AI operating model (The Forge) and Care Center frontline operations (AWS Connect, Kimberly Dorsett). Own translation of enterprise agentic roadmap into measurable Care Center adoption, reusable primitives, and governed human-in-the-loop systems.
job_description.company_context: Briefing context: Truist CAIO Pascal Belaud drives The Forge (production-first, Azure-centric governance). Charles Morris owns the Agentic Enterprise strategy—compounding capabilities, digital teammates with accountable human bosses, reusable blocks vs point solutions. Care Centers need AWS-native agent-assist, call summarization, and Client Pulse-style context engines without shadow IT. Ideal outreach angle: Amit builds governed agentic systems (routing, guardrails, observability) and wants Charles's view on how enablement leaders should deliver primitives that compound for Morris's roadmap while satisfying Forge compliance.
responsibilities: Translate enterprise agentic strategy into Care Center-ready capabilities
Deliver reusable primitives (intent, unified customer memory) not one-off pilots
Navigate Azure Forge standards vs AWS Connect operational reality
Drive frontline adoption with bounded agents and audit trails
